newsitem.title: UK: Higher UK meals and feeds prices chase buyers away.
newsitem.headline: Higher UK meals and feeds prices chase buyers away.

text.p: Firmer high protein soymeal prices drove most buyers out of the UK meals and feeds market on Thursday.
Prices rose as a result of higher Chicago futures on the back of concerns over the affect of the strengthening El Nino weather pattern on crops.
Recent reports suggest that El Nino may affect crops in Asia, Australia and India, but so far there is nothing conclusive for the U.S. grain areas.
"This is really crazy, at the beginning of the week we were told that growing conditions were near prefect," said one broker
High protein prices in the UK rose by five to two stg a tonne ex-mill and around five stg ex-store.
All other sectors of the market were unchanged.
